title: MovieDB
short_description: A ReactJS-based movie browser that pulls real-time data from TheMovieDB API to showcase trending films.
full_description: MovieDB is a web application built with using ReactJS and styled using TailwindCSS. The application is connected to TheMovieDB API to fetch live data that is stored in the browser's local storage. The core functionality revolves around fetching and displaying a list of movies, each represented with a poster image, title, release date, and rating. Users can click on any movie card to view a detailed page which includes additional information such as the full description and genres. The app also allows users to add movies to a Favourites list, which is cached using the browser's local storage and displayed on the Favourites page for quick access.
